verdicts.reason: A breaks the product art: the cream circle has slid down to the bottom-left corner and is cut off by the canvas edge, so the orange can blends into the orange background and only its label band and dots are left floating. B keeps the cream circle behind the can, so the product reads properly. Both still have the same flaws: the NEW badge has been blown up to button size and competes with the Try It CTA, the headline and subcopy are left-aligned while the buttons are centred, and the buttons are jammed against the subcopy with the CTA pushed close to the bottom edge.
